snippet.title: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree - teaser
snippet.description:
Stamperor! The Jester's Decree is a city-building game where the kingdom grows based on whether you approve or deny requests made by your citizens.

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4551150/Stamperor_The_Jesters_Decree/
